reviews.text: amazing owner. such a nice place with locally sourced treats. i was able to find all the yappetizer treats (!) parking available. will visit again.
My dog loves this place and so do we! The owner is the nicest person you’ll ever meet and his product recommendations are always top notch!
Raymond is absolutely amazing. Always brightens my day when I go in for dog food and it definitely brightens my dog's day. He starts whining in the car as we pull up because he's so excited
Friendly service and high quality products. You get what you pay for!
Raymond clearly loves dogs as much as they love him (and his treats). I always appreciate his recommendations when I can't figure out what I want to get.
The worker was really nice and super enthusiastic. He helped me pick out nice treats for my picky dog and had a widespread variety of options. Overall really nice store, and a really nice guy.
Great store! Lots of good products and super friendly and helpful staff 👍🏻👍🏻 …
Great pet store. They offer a lot of different options for dog raw food and Raymond was extremely knowledgeable and helpful. Truly enjoyed his recommendations and his energy.

No one loves Raymond more than my puppies! We’ve been coming for years and years for all of our treats and food. Raymond is very knowledgeable about the different proteins and lines he carries.  He also cares very much about every customer, doggie and human that walks through the door!
Warm and welcoming. Best pet store in Vancouver.

Earlier this year, I joined my dear friend, Leanne, to go shopping at this magnificent pet supplies store that she regularly shops at ONLY for her beloved doggie, as she fully trusts and appreciates the extremely knowledgeable, kindhearted, and personable, attentive service she always receives from the owner himself at WOOF GANG PET SUPPLIES!
I ended up buying a few treats for her doggie and another good friend's doggie, named Shadow, and kept asking him what treats the owner suggested and why. He quickly responded with a detailed explanation as to his personal opinion, first asking me what kind of dog I was buying treats for as he already knew what kind of dog my friend Leanne had; he patiently explained the differences between each of the treats I picked and what was good about them for the dogs. Believe me, the store offered a wide variety of tasty treats as well as healthy treats.

If I had a pet, WOOF GANG PET SUPPLIES would most definitely be the ONE and ONLY pet supplies store to get ANYTHING I needed for my beloved pet!
Thank you for your kindness and excellent customer V.I.P. service! 🐾🏆
This is a great pet supplies store! Incredible selection and they are very helpful and welcoming.
Amazing pet store! I love Raymond’s passion and the way he cares for his customers. His guidance, product knowledge, and support for locally made brands truly make a difference.
Raymond is extremely knowledgeable and helpful

Raymond was super knowledgeable and extremely helpful when picking out a raw dog food and treats for our new puppy. Highly recommend checking out the shop and all of the high quality products they have!

I always enjoy visiting Woofgang Pet Supplies. It’s one of the few places where I can reliably find my dog’s favourite treats—especially the ones that are hard to come by elsewhere.

Raymond is always so helpful, knowledgeable, and genuinely kind. He’s lovely to chat with about all things—pets, the neighbourhood, you name it—and you can really tell he loves the community. He goes above and beyond to make sure you find exactly what you need.

It’s always a pleasure to stop in, and I know my pup is getting the best.
Such great service and products ❤️
Our dog absolutely loves this store and the attention she gets from the owner. A good selection of treats and toys. A real gem.

Raymond helped us pick out dog treats and a new leash. He was super knowledgeable about the treats (local manufacturer, ingredients, common dog preferences). We even got a shoulder sling leash based on his recommendation, and my wife and I have also been really happy with this purchase. Wonderful shop and I was happy we stopped by.

Stopped in with my service dog while travelling in BC from Vancouver. A total gem of a store! They were so friendly and helpful, and had lots of unique products that were locally sourced! Definitely recommend stopping in :)
